children: According to the announcement from Binance, U.S. Stock Trading on Binance will be temporarily unavailable because of a scheduled system upgrade by its partner broker. During the upgrade window, users will not be able to place stock trading orders. The system upgrade is scheduled for 2026-09-05 10:50 (UTC) to 2026-09-05 14:00 (UTC), and Binance said the downtime is expected to fall within that period, although it may end earlier or extend if additional work is required. The company added that the upgrade is scheduled outside of U.S. regular market trading hours. Once the system upgrade is completed, stock trading services will automatically resume. Binance also advised users to plan their trading activity accordingly.

The announcement said the temporary service interruption applies to U.S. Stock Trading on Binance and that the affected products and services may not be available in every region. Binance did not indicate any change to the service beyond the scheduled maintenance window. The notice stated that trading access will return automatically after the upgrade is finished, without requiring additional action from users. The announcement also included the date 2026-09-04 and identified the notice as a general announcement. No further operational details were provided beyond the timing of the upgrade and the temporary suspension of stock trading orders during that period.

title: Binance Stock Trading Will Be Temporarily Unavailable During Scheduled System Upgrade
